brief.summary: Equity futures are higher, with S&P and Nasdaq up about 0.6-0.9% after a four-day slide, while Treasury yields remain elevated: 2-year near 4.60%, 10-year near 5%, 30-year around 5.35%. Oil is the dominant macro driver, with Brent around $104 after a roughly 20% August-to-date surge, although crude is retreating today. The Fed is expected to hike next Wednesday; market pricing moved to roughly 70-90% after core CPI came in hot at 0.3% m/m. The show's tone is cautious and inflation-focused, with bond-market credibility and rising term premium debated. Dollar and gold were not discussed.
